import math

class Point(int x, int y)

class Rectangle(int x0, int y0, int x1, int y1)
    bool empty()
        return x0 > x1 or y0 > y1

    bool contains(Point point)
        return x0 <= point.x <= x1 and y0 <= point.y <= y1

    Rectangle intersection(Rectangle other)
        return Rectangle(math.max(x0, other.x0), math.max(y0, other.y0), math.min(x1, other.x1), math.min(y1, other.y1))

    distinct<int> pixels(int image_width)
        distinct<int> result
        for: y0 <= row <= y1
            for: x0 <= column <= x1
                .result.add(row * image_width + column)
        return result

class Color(int r, int g, int b, a := 255)
    int[] channels()
        return [r, g, b, a]

    (int, int, int, int) key()
        return (r, g, b, a)

    bool before(Color other)
        first := channels()
        second := other.channels()
        for: index < 4
            if first[index] != second[index]
                return first[index] < second[index]
        return false

    string rgb_text()
        return "{r} {g} {b}"

    string text()
        return "{r} {g} {b} {a}"

Color from_channels(int[] values)
    return Color(values[0], values[1], values[2], if #values == 4 then values[3] else 255)

int floor_divide(int numerator, int denominator)
    if numerator >= 0
        return numerator / denominator
    return -((-numerator + denominator - 1) / denominator)

int round_ratio(int numerator, int denominator)
    upper := if denominator < 0 then -numerator else numerator
    lower := math.abs(denominator)
    return floor_divide(2 * upper + lower, 2 * lower)

int effective_alpha(int alpha, int opacity)
    return round_ratio(alpha * opacity, 255)

class Layer(int width, int height, int opacity, string mode)
    painted := array(nat(width * height), fill = false)
    colors := array(nat(width * height), fill = Color(0, 0, 0, 0))
    lines := array(nat(width * height), fill = 0)

    void .paint(int pixel, Color value, int source_line)
        painted[pixel] = true
        colors[pixel] = value
        lines[pixel] = source_line

    void .erase(int pixel)
        painted[pixel] = false

    int alpha_at(int pixel)
        return if painted[pixel] then effective_alpha(colors[pixel].a, opacity) else 0

    bool same_value(int first, int second)
        return painted[first] == painted[second] and (not painted[first] or colors[first] == colors[second])

    Color blend(int pixel, Color current)
        if not painted[pixel]
            return current
        value := colors[pixel]
        alpha := effective_alpha(value.a, opacity)
        sources := value.channels()
        previous := current.channels()
        int[] result := []
        for: index < 3
            source := sources[index]
            old := previous[index]
            mixed := if mode == "multiply" then round_ratio(source * old, 255) elif mode == "screen" then 255 - round_ratio((255 - source) * (255 - old), 255) else source
            result = result.append(round_ratio(alpha * mixed + (255 - alpha) * old, 255))
        return from_channels(result)

Color[] composite(Layer[] layers, Color background, int width, int height)
    Color[] result := []
    for: pixel < width * height
        current := background
        for layer := layers[]
            current = layer.blend(pixel, current)
        result = result.append(current)
    return result

import canvas = "./canvas.qui"

int region_code(canvas.Point point, canvas.Rectangle clip)
    return (if point.x < clip.x0 then 1 else 0) + (if point.x > clip.x1 then 2 else 0) + (if point.y < clip.y0 then 4 else 0) + (if point.y > clip.y1 then 8 else 0)

bool has_bit(int code, int flag)
    return code / flag % 2 == 1

canvas.Point[] clip_segment(canvas.Point first, canvas.Point last, canvas.Rectangle clip)
    start := first
    end := last
    while true
        start_code := region_code(start, clip)
        end_code := region_code(end, clip)
        if start_code == 0 and end_code == 0
            return [start, end]
        for flag := [1, 2, 4, 8][]
            if has_bit(start_code, flag) and has_bit(end_code, flag)
                return []
        code := if start_code != 0 then start_code else end_code
        a := if start_code != 0 then start else end
        b := if start_code != 0 then end else start
        canvas.Point replacement
        if has_bit(code, 4)
            replacement = canvas.Point(a.x + canvas.round_ratio((b.x - a.x) * (clip.y0 - a.y), b.y - a.y), clip.y0)
        elif has_bit(code, 8)
            replacement = canvas.Point(a.x + canvas.round_ratio((b.x - a.x) * (clip.y1 - a.y), b.y - a.y), clip.y1)
        elif has_bit(code, 2)
            replacement = canvas.Point(clip.x1, a.y + canvas.round_ratio((b.y - a.y) * (clip.x1 - a.x), b.x - a.x))
        else
            replacement = canvas.Point(clip.x0, a.y + canvas.round_ratio((b.y - a.y) * (clip.x0 - a.x), b.x - a.x))
        if start_code != 0
            start = replacement
        else
            end = replacement

bool inside(canvas.Point point, int axis, int limit, bool minimum)
    value := if axis == 0 then point.x else point.y
    return if minimum then value >= limit else value <= limit

canvas.Point intersection(canvas.Point start, canvas.Point end, int axis, int limit)
    if axis == 0
        return canvas.Point(limit, start.y + canvas.round_ratio((limit - start.x) * (end.y - start.y), end.x - start.x))
    return canvas.Point(start.x + canvas.round_ratio((limit - start.y) * (end.x - start.x), end.y - start.y), limit)

canvas.Point[] clip_polygon(canvas.Point[] vertices, canvas.Rectangle clip)
    int[][] boundaries := [[0, clip.x0, 1], [0, clip.x1 + 1, 0], [1, clip.y0, 1], [1, clip.y1 + 1, 0]]
    current := vertices
    for boundary := boundaries[]
        axis := boundary[0]
        limit := boundary[1]
        minimum := boundary[2] == 1
        canvas.Point[] output := []
        for: index < #current
            end := current[index]
            start := current[(int(index) + int(#current) - 1) % int(#current)]
            if inside(end, axis, limit, minimum)
                if not inside(start, axis, limit, minimum)
                    output = output.append(intersection(start, end, axis, limit))
                output = output.append(end)
            elif inside(start, axis, limit, minimum)
                output = output.append(intersection(start, end, axis, limit))
        current = output
    return current

import math
import canvas = "./canvas.qui"

class Edge(canvas.Point start, canvas.Point end)

int[] crossing_at(map<int, int[]> values, int key)
    match values.get(key)
        int[] found
            return found
        none
            return [0, 0]

distinct<int> polygons(canvas.Point[][] sequences, string rule, canvas.Rectangle clip, int width)
    Edge[] edges := []
    for vertices := sequences[]
        for: index < #vertices
            start := vertices[index]
            end := vertices[(index + 1) % #vertices]
            if start.y != end.y
                edges = edges.append(Edge(start, end))
    distinct<int> pixels
    for: clip.y0 <= y <= clip.y1
        map<int, int[]> crossings
        for edge := edges[]
            a := edge.start
            b := edge.end
            if math.min(a.y, b.y) <= y < math.max(a.y, b.y)
                denominator := b.y - a.y
                numerator := 2 * a.x * denominator + (2 * y + 1 - 2 * a.y) * (b.x - a.x)
                if denominator < 0
                    denominator = -denominator
                    numerator = -numerator
                first := canvas.floor_divide(numerator - denominator, 2 * denominator) + 1
                previous := crossing_at(crossings, first)
                .crossings.set(first, [previous[0] + 1, previous[1] + (if b.y > a.y then 1 else -1)])
        positions := crossings.keys().sorted()
        index := 0
        count := 0
        winding := 0
        for: clip.x0 <= x <= clip.x1
            while index < int(#positions) and positions[index] <= x
                crossing := crossing_at(crossings, positions[index])
                count += crossing[0]
                winding += crossing[1]
                index += 1
            painted := if rule == "evenodd" then count % 2 == 1 else winding != 0
            if painted
                .pixels.add(y * width + x)
    return pixels

distinct<int> shape(canvas.Point center, canvas.Point[] points, canvas.Rectangle clip, int width)
    map<int, int> extents
    for point := points[]
        previous := 0
        match extents.get(point.y)
            int found
                previous = found
            none
                previous = 0
        .extents.set(point.y, math.max(previous, math.abs(point.x)))
    distinct<int> pixels
    for dy := extents.keys()[]
        y := center.y + dy
        if clip.y0 <= y <= clip.y1
            match extents.get(dy)
                int extent
                    for: math.max(clip.x0, center.x - extent) <= x <= math.min(clip.x1, center.x + extent)
                        .pixels.add(y * width + x)
                none
                    continue
    return pixels

distinct<int> flood(canvas.Layer layer, canvas.Point seed, canvas.Rectangle clip)
    first := seed.y * layer.width + seed.x
    distinct<int> pixels
    .pixels.add(first)
    pending := [first]
    while #pending != 0
        pixel := pending[-1]
        pending = pending[0:<#pending - 1]
        x := pixel % layer.width
        y := pixel / layer.width
        adjacent := [canvas.Point(x + 1, y), canvas.Point(x - 1, y), canvas.Point(x, y + 1), canvas.Point(x, y - 1)]
        for point := adjacent[]
            if not clip.contains(point)
                continue
            next := point.y * layer.width + point.x
            if not pixels.has(next) and layer.same_value(first, next)
                .pixels.add(next)
                pending = pending.append(next)
    return pixels

bool contains_word(string[] values, string wanted)

string[] read_lines(string path)
    string text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    lines := text.split(NL)
    if #lines > 0 and lines[-1] == ""
        lines = lines[0:<#lines - 1]

string[] words_of(string text)
    string[] result := []
    for word := text.split(" ")[]
        if word != ""
            result = result.append(word)
    return result

int[] integers(string[] values)
    int[] result := []
    for value := values[]
        result = result.append(int(value))
    return result

int count_at<K>(map<K, int> values, K key)
    match values.get(key)
        int found
            return found
        none
            return 0

class Styles()
    colors := map<string, canvas.Color>()
    pens := map<string, Pen>()
    brushes := map<string, Brush>()

Styles read_styles()
    result := Styles()
    for text := read_lines("input/styles.txt")[]
        if text == "" or text.starts_with("#")
            continue
        words := text.split(" ")
        if words[0] == "color"
            .result.colors.set(words[1], canvas.from_channels(integers(words[2:<#words])))
        elif words[0] == "pen"
            .result.pens.set(words[1], Pen(int(words[2]), words[3], int(words[4]), int(words[5])))
        elif words[0] == "brush"
            .result.brushes.set(words[1], Brush([words[2]], "", words[3]))
        else
            .result.brushes.set(words[1], Brush([words[2], words[3]], words[4], words[5]))
    return result

class Font(int width, int height, map<string, canvas.Point[]> glyphs)

canvas.Point[] | error glyph_value(map<string, canvas.Point[]> values, string key)
    match values.get(key)
        canvas.Point[] found
            return found
        none
            return error("missing glyph {key}")

Font read_font()
    lines := read_lines("input/font.txt")
    header := lines[0].split(" ")
    width := int(header[1])
    height := int(header[2])
    map<string, canvas.Point[]> glyphs
    position := 1
    while position < int(#lines)
        words := lines[position].split(" ")
        character := words[1]
        position += 1
        canvas.Point[] points := []
        for: row < height
            for: column < width
                if lines[position + row][column] == "#"
                    points = points.append(canvas.Point(column, row))
        position += height
        .glyphs.set(character, points)
    return Font(width, height, glyphs)

class SourceLine(int number, string[] words)
class Block(string name, int first, int last, int end_line, opacity := 255, mode := "normal")

class Scene(int width, int height, string background, SourceLine[] lines, Block[] layers, Block[] symbols, map<int, int> repetitions)
    int symbol_index(string key)
        for: index < #symbols
            if symbols[index].name == key
                return int(index)
        return -1

Scene read_scene()
    raw := read_lines("input/scene.txt")
    SourceLine[] lines := []
    for: index < #raw
        words := words_of(raw[index])
        if #words > 0 and not words[0].starts_with("#")
            lines = lines.append(SourceLine(int(index) + 1, words))
    int[] stack := []
    map<int, int> repetitions
    for: index < #lines
        keyword := lines[index].words[0]
        if keyword == "REPEAT"
            stack = stack.append(int(index))
        elif keyword == "ENDREPEAT"
            first := stack[-1]
            stack = stack[0:<#stack - 1]
            .repetitions.set(first, int(index))
    Block[] layers := []
    Block[] symbols := []
    position := 1
    while position < int(#lines)
        words := lines[position].words
        first := position + 1
        last := first
        while lines[last].words[0] != "END"
            last += 1
        if words[0] == "LAYER"
            layers = layers.append(Block(words[1], first, last, lines[last].number, int(words[2]), words[3]))
        else
            symbols = symbols.append(Block(words[1], first, last, lines[last].number))
        position = last + 1
    header := lines[0].words
    return Scene(int(header[1]), int(header[2]), header[3], lines, layers, symbols, repetitions)

class Probe(string kind, int[] values)

Probe[] read_probes()
    Probe[] result := []

class Command(int line, string keyword, string[] arguments)
    int number(int index)
        return int(arguments[index])

class PathCommand(string letter, int[] values)
class Subpath(canvas.Point[] points, closed := false)

bool integer_word(string text)
    digits := if text.starts_with("-") then text[1:<#text] else text
    if #digits == 0
        return false
    for point := digits.codepoints()[]
        if point < 48 or point > 57
            return false
    return true

string path_kind(string letter)
    upper := "MLHVQCZ"
    lower := "mlhvqcz"
    for: index < #upper
        if letter == upper[index] or letter == lower[index]
            return upper[index]
    return ""

int path_arity(string letter)
    kind := path_kind(letter)
    if kind == "M" or kind == "L"
        return 2
    if kind == "H" or kind == "V"
        return 1
    if kind == "Q"
        return 4
    if kind == "C"
        return 6
    return if kind == "Z" then 0 else -1

PathCommand[] | none parse_path(string[] words)
    PathCommand[] result := []
    position := 0
    while position < int(#words)
        letter := words[position]
        count := path_arity(letter)
        if count < 0 or position + count >= int(#words)
            return none
        requires_move := #result == 0 or path_kind(result[-1].letter) == "Z"
        if requires_move and path_kind(letter) != "M"
            return none
        values := words[position + 1:<position + count + 1]
        for value := values[]
            if not integer_word(value)
                return none
        result = result.append(PathCommand(letter, integers(values)))
        position += count + 1
    return if #result == 0 then none else result

bool path_form(string[] words)
    match parse_path(words)
        PathCommand[] found
            return true
        none
            return false

PathCommand[] | error path_value(string[] words)
    match parse_path(words)
        PathCommand[] found
            return found
        none
            return error("invalid path")

class Matrix(a := 1, b := 0, c := 0, d := 1, e := 0, f := 0)
    canvas.Point point(int x, int y)
        return canvas.Point(a * x + b * y + e, c * x + d * y + f)

    canvas.Rectangle rectangle(int x0, int y0, int x1, int y1)
        canvas.Point first := point(x0, y0)
        canvas.Point last := point(x1, y1)
        return canvas.Rectangle(math.min(first.x, last.x), math.min(first.y, last.y), math.max(first.x, last.x), math.max(first.y, last.y))

    canvas.Point radii(int rx, int ry)
        return canvas.Point(math.abs(a) * rx + math.abs(b) * ry, math.abs(c) * rx + math.abs(d) * ry)

    Matrix translated(int dx, int dy)
        return Matrix(a, b, c, d, e + a * dx + b * dy, f + c * dx + d * dy)

    Matrix scaled(int sx, int sy)
        return Matrix(a * sx, b * sy, c * sx, d * sy, e, f)

    Matrix rotated(int count)
        result := Matrix(a, b, c, d, e, f)
        for: index < (count % 4 + 4) % 4
            result = Matrix(result.b, -result.a, result.d, -result.c, result.e, result.f)
        return result

class Frame(Matrix matrix, canvas.Rectangle clip)

class DrawingState(canvas.Rectangle clip)
    matrix := Matrix()
    Frame[] stack := []

class Segment(canvas.Point start, canvas.Point end)

Segment[] segments(canvas.Point[] points, bool closed)
    Segment[] result := []
    for: index < int(#points) - 1
        result = result.append(Segment(points[index], points[index + 1]))
    if closed
        result = result.append(Segment(points[-1], points[0]))
    return result

Subpath[] build_subpaths(PathCommand[] commands, Matrix transform, int count)
    Subpath[] result := []
    current := canvas.Point(0, 0)
    start := current
    for command := commands[]
        kind := path_kind(command.letter)
        if kind == "Z"
            result[-1].closed = true
            current = start
            continue
        relative := "mlhvqcz".contains(command.letter)
        ox := if relative then current.x else 0
        oy := if relative then current.y else 0
        values := command.values
        canvas.Point[] points := []
        if kind == "H"
            points = [canvas.Point(values[0] + ox, current.y)]
        elif kind == "V"
            points = [canvas.Point(current.x, values[0] + oy)]
        else
            for: index < int(#values) step 2
                points = points.append(canvas.Point(values[index] + ox, values[index + 1] + oy))
        if kind == "M"
            start = points[0]
            result = result.append(Subpath([transform.point(start.x, start.y)]))
        elif kind == "Q" or kind == "C"
            last := int(#result) - 1
            controls := [result[last].points[-1]]
            for control := points[]
                controls = controls.append(transform.point(control.x, control.y))
            curve := primitives.bezier_points(controls, count)
            result[last].points = result[last].points.concat(curve[1:<#curve])
        else
            last := int(#result) - 1
            result[last].points = result[last].points.append(transform.point(points[0].x, points[0].y))
        current = points[-1]
    return result

canvas.Rectangle bounding_box(distinct<int> pixels, int width, int height)
    if pixels.size() == 0
        return canvas.Rectangle(0, 0, -1, -1)
    x0 := width
    y0 := height
    x1 := -1
    y1 := -1
    for pixel := pixels.values()[]
        x := pixel % width
        y := pixel / width
        x0 = math.min(x0, x)
        y0 = math.min(y0, y)
        x1 = math.max(x1, x)
        y1 = math.max(y1, y)
    return canvas.Rectangle(x0, y0, x1, y1)

string box_text(canvas.Rectangle box)
    return if box.empty() then "none" else "{box.x0} {box.y0} {box.x1} {box.y1}"

class ColorCount(canvas.Color color, int count)

bool color_count_before(ColorCount first, ColorCount second)
    return if first.count != second.count then first.count > second.count else first.color.before(second.color)

ColorCount[] ranked_colors(map<(int, int, int, int), int> counts)
    ColorCount[] result := []
    for (r, g, b, a) := counts.keys()[]
        result = result.append(ColorCount(canvas.Color(r, g, b, a), count_at(counts, (r, g, b, a))))
    for: 1 <= index < int(#result)
        entry := result[index]
        position := index
        while position > 0 and color_count_before(entry, result[position - 1])
            result[position] = result[position - 1]
            position -= 1
        result[position] = entry
    return result

map<(int, int, int, int), int> color_counts(canvas.Color[] values)
    map<(int, int, int, int), int> result
    for color := values[]
        .result.set(color.key(), count_at(result, color.key()) + 1)
    return result

class Form(int count, int first_integer)

Form | none fixed_form(string keyword)
    if contains_word(["LINE", "RECT", "FILLRECT", "ELLIPSE", "FILLELLIPSE"], keyword)
        return Form(5, 1)
    if keyword == "CIRCLE" or keyword == "FILLCIRCLE"
        return Form(4, 1)
    if keyword == "FLOOD" or keyword == "USE"
        return Form(3, 1)
    if keyword == "ERASE" or keyword == "CLIP"
        return Form(4, 0)
    if keyword == "TRANSLATE" or keyword == "SCALE"
        return Form(2, 0)
    if keyword == "ROTATE"
        return Form(1, 0)
    if contains_word(["SAVE", "RESTORE", "NOCLIP"], keyword)
        return Form(0, 0)
    return none

class Execution(int layer, Command command, string kind, problem := "", pixels := 0, box := "none")

class KeywordTally()
    executed := 0
    errors := 0
    pixels := 0

class Renderer(Styles styles, Font font, Scene scene, Probe[] probes)
    full_screen := canvas.Rectangle(0, 0, scene.width - 1, scene.height - 1)
    canvas.Layer[] layers := []
    for block := scene.layers[]
        layers = layers.append(canvas.Layer(scene.width, scene.height, block.opacity, block.mode))
    Execution[] executions := []
    used_pens := distinct<string>()
    used_brushes := distinct<string>()
    symbol_uses := map<string, int>()

    bool valid_form(Command entry)
        arguments := entry.arguments
        name := entry.keyword
        match fixed_form(name)
            Form form
                if int(#arguments) != form.count
                    return false
                for: form.first_integer <= index < form.count
                    if not integer_word(arguments[index])
                        return false
                return true
            none
                if contains_word(["POLYLINE", "POLYGON", "FILLPOLYGON"], name)
                    if #arguments < 2
                        return false
                    for: 1 <= index < int(#arguments)
                        if not integer_word(arguments[index])
                            return false
                    return int(#arguments) == 2 + 2 * entry.number(1)
                if name == "PATH" or name == "FILLPATH"
                    return #arguments >= 2 and integer_word(arguments[1]) and path_form(arguments[2:<#arguments])
                return #arguments == 5 and integer_word(arguments[1]) and integer_word(arguments[2])

    string command_error(Command entry, DrawingState state)
        name := entry.keyword
        arguments := entry.arguments
        if not contains_word(pen_commands(), name) and not contains_word(brush_commands(), name) and not contains_word(state_commands(), name) and name != "ERASE"
            return "unknown_command"
        if not valid_form(entry)
            return "bad_arguments"
        if (contains_word(pen_commands(), name) and not styles.pens.has(arguments[0])) or (contains_word(brush_commands(), name) and not styles.brushes.has(arguments[0]))
            return "unknown_style"
        if name == "USE"
            symbol := scene.symbol_index(arguments[0])
            if symbol < 0 or scene.symbols[symbol].end_line > entry.line
                return "unknown_symbol"
        if name == "TEXT"
            for: index < #arguments[4]
                character := arguments[4][index]
                if character != "_" and not font.glyphs.has(character)
                    return "unknown_glyph"
        invalid := false
        if name == "CIRCLE" or name == "FILLCIRCLE"
            invalid = entry.number(3) < 1
        elif name == "ELLIPSE" or name == "FILLELLIPSE"
            invalid = entry.number(3) < 1 or entry.number(4) < 1
        elif name == "POLYLINE"
            invalid = entry.number(1) < 2
        elif name == "POLYGON" or name == "FILLPOLYGON"
            invalid = entry.number(1) < 3
        elif name == "PATH" or name == "FILLPATH"
            invalid = entry.number(1) < 1 or entry.number(1) > 32
        elif name == "FLOOD"
            invalid = not state.clip.contains(state.matrix.point(entry.number(1), entry.number(2)))
        elif name == "TEXT"
            invalid = not contains_word(["left", "center", "right"], arguments[3])
        elif name == "SCALE"
            invalid = entry.number(0) == 0 or entry.number(1) == 0
        elif name == "CLIP"
            invalid = state.clip.intersection(state.matrix.rectangle(entry.number(0), entry.number(1), entry.number(2), entry.number(3))).empty()
        if invalid
            return "bad_value"
        if name == "RESTORE" and #state.stack == 0
            return "stack_empty"
        return ""

    void expand_into(distinct<int> &pixels, canvas.Point point, int width, canvas.Rectangle clip)
        for expanded := primitives.expand_square(point, width)[]
            if clip.contains(expanded)
                .pixels.add(expanded.y * scene.width + expanded.x)

    distinct<int> pen_pixels(Segment[] parts, Pen pen, canvas.Rectangle clip)
        canvas.Point[] points := []
        for part := parts[]
            ends := clipping.clip_segment(part.start, part.end, clip)
            if #ends == 2
                points = points.concat(primitives.bresenham(ends[0], ends[1]))
        distinct<int> result
        for: index < #points
            if pen.off == 0 or int(index) % (pen.on + pen.off) < pen.on
                expand_into(&result, points[index], pen.width, clip)
        return result

    distinct<int> text_pixels(Command entry, DrawingState state)
        text := entry.arguments[4]
        extent := int(#text) * (font.width + 1) - 1
        x := entry.number(1)
        y := entry.number(2)
        alignment := entry.arguments[3]
        left := if alignment == "center" then x - extent / 2 elif alignment == "right" then x - extent + 1 else x
        distinct<int> result
        for: index < #text
            character := text[index]
            if character == "_"
                continue
            origin := left + int(index) * (font.width + 1)
            glyph := glyph_value(font.glyphs, character)
            for point := glyph[]
                canvas.Rectangle box := state.matrix.rectangle(origin + point.x, y + point.y, origin + point.x + 1, y + point.y + 1)
                cells := canvas.Rectangle(box.x0, box.y0, box.x1 - 1, box.y1 - 1).intersection(state.clip)
                for pixel := cells.pixels(scene.width).values()[]
                    .result.add(pixel)
        return result

    distinct<int> coverage(Command entry, DrawingState state, int layer_index)
        name := entry.keyword
        arguments := entry.arguments
        Matrix transform := state.matrix
        clip := state.clip
        distinct<int> result
        if name == "ERASE"
            area := transform.rectangle(entry.number(0), entry.number(1), entry.number(2), entry.number(3)).intersection(clip)
            for pixel := area.pixels(scene.width).values()[]
                if layers[layer_index].painted[pixel]
                    .result.add(pixel)
            return result
        if name == "FLOOD"
            return fill.flood(layers[layer_index], transform.point(entry.number(1), entry.number(2)), clip)
        if name == "TEXT"
            return text_pixels(entry, state)
        if name == "FILLRECT"
            return transform.rectangle(entry.number(1), entry.number(2), entry.number(3), entry.number(4)).intersection(clip).pixels(scene.width)
        if contains_word(["CIRCLE", "FILLCIRCLE", "ELLIPSE", "FILLELLIPSE"], name)
            center := transform.point(entry.number(1), entry.number(2))
            circle := name == "CIRCLE" or name == "FILLCIRCLE"
            radii := transform.radii(entry.number(3), if circle then entry.number(3) else entry.number(4))
            points := if circle and radii.x == radii.y then primitives.circle_points(radii.x) else primitives.ellipse_points(radii.x, radii.y)
            if name == "FILLCIRCLE" or name == "FILLELLIPSE"
                return fill.shape(center, points, clip, scene.width)
            pen := pen_value(styles.pens, arguments[0])
            for point := points[]
                expand_into(&result, canvas.Point(center.x + point.x, center.y + point.y), pen.width, clip)
            return result
        if name == "PATH" or name == "FILLPATH"
            data := path_value(arguments[2:<#arguments])
            paths := build_subpaths(data, transform, entry.number(1))
            if name == "FILLPATH"
                canvas.Point[][] clipped := []
                for path := paths[]
                    clipped = clipped.append(clipping.clip_polygon(path.points, clip))
                brush := brush_value(styles.brushes, arguments[0])
                return fill.polygons(clipped, brush.rule, clip, scene.width)
            Segment[] parts := []
            for path := paths[]
                parts = parts.concat(segments(path.points, path.closed))
            pen := pen_value(styles.pens, arguments[0])
            return pen_pixels(parts, pen, clip)
        canvas.Point[] vertices := []
        if name == "RECT"
            box := transform.rectangle(entry.number(1), entry.number(2), entry.number(3), entry.number(4))
            vertices = [canvas.Point(box.x0, box.y0), canvas.Point(box.x1, box.y0), canvas.Point(box.x1, box.y1), canvas.Point(box.x0, box.y1)]
        elif name == "LINE"
            vertices = [transform.point(entry.number(1), entry.number(2)), transform.point(entry.number(3), entry.number(4))]
        else
            for: 2 <= index < int(#arguments) step 2
                vertices = vertices.append(transform.point(entry.number(index), entry.number(index + 1)))
        if name == "FILLPOLYGON"
            brush := brush_value(styles.brushes, arguments[0])
            return fill.polygons([clipping.clip_polygon(vertices, clip)], brush.rule, clip, scene.width)
        pen := pen_value(styles.pens, arguments[0])
        return pen_pixels(segments(vertices, name == "RECT" or name == "POLYGON"), pen, clip)

    void .paint_pixels(distinct<int> pixels, Command entry, int layer_index)
        if entry.keyword == "ERASE"
            for pixel := pixels.values()[]
                .layers[layer_index].erase(pixel)
            return
        style_name := entry.arguments[0]
        if contains_word(pen_commands(), entry.keyword)
            .used_pens.add(style_name)
            pen := pen_value(styles.pens, style_name)
            color := color_value(styles.colors, pen.color_name)
            for pixel := pixels.values()[]
                .layers[layer_index].paint(pixel, color, entry.line)
            return
        .used_brushes.add(style_name)
        brush := brush_value(styles.brushes, style_name)
        box := bounding_box(pixels, scene.width, scene.height)
        if box.empty()
            return
        first := color_value(styles.colors, brush.color_names[0])
        for pixel := pixels.values()[]
            color := first
            if #brush.color_names == 2
                second := color_value(styles.colors, brush.color_names[1])
                x := pixel % scene.width
                y := pixel / scene.width
                offset := if brush.axis == "x" then x - box.x0 else y - box.y0
                length := if brush.axis == "x" then box.x1 - box.x0 else box.y1 - box.y0
                if length > 0
                    initial := first.channels()
                    final_values := second.channels()
                    int[] channels := []
                    for: index < 4
                        channels = channels.append(initial[index] + canvas.round_ratio((final_values[index] - initial[index]) * offset, length))
                    color = canvas.from_channels(channels)
            .layers[layer_index].paint(pixel, color, entry.line)

    int .execute(Command entry, int layer_index, DrawingState &state)
        string problem := command_error(entry, state)
        if problem != ""
            executions = executions.append(Execution(layer_index, entry, "error", problem))
            return -1
        if not contains_word(state_commands(), entry.keyword)
            distinct<int> pixels := coverage(entry, state, layer_index)
            .paint_pixels(pixels, entry, layer_index)
            box := box_text(bounding_box(pixels, scene.width, scene.height))
            executions = executions.append(Execution(layer_index, entry, "drawing", pixels = int(pixels.size()), box = box))
            return -1
        executions = executions.append(Execution(layer_index, entry, "state"))
        name := entry.keyword
        if name == "TRANSLATE"
            state.matrix = state.matrix.translated(entry.number(0), entry.number(1))
        elif name == "SCALE"
            state.matrix = state.matrix.scaled(entry.number(0), entry.number(1))
        elif name == "ROTATE"
            state.matrix = state.matrix.rotated(entry.number(0))
        elif name == "SAVE"
            state.stack = state.stack.append(Frame(state.matrix, state.clip))
        elif name == "RESTORE"
            saved := state.stack[-1]
            state.stack = state.stack[0:<#state.stack - 1]
            state.matrix = saved.matrix
            state.clip = saved.clip
        elif name == "CLIP"
            state.clip = state.clip.intersection(state.matrix.rectangle(entry.number(0), entry.number(1), entry.number(2), entry.number(3)))
        elif name == "NOCLIP"
            state.clip = canvas.Rectangle(full_screen.x0, full_screen.y0, full_screen.x1, full_screen.y1)
        else
            symbol_name := entry.arguments[0]
            .symbol_uses.set(symbol_name, count_at(symbol_uses, symbol_name) + 1)
            return scene.symbol_index(symbol_name)
        return -1

    void .execute_block(int first, int last, int layer_index, DrawingState &state)
        position := first
        while position < last
            source := scene.lines[position]
            words := source.words
            if words[0] == "REPEAT"
                closing := count_at(scene.repetitions, position)
                count := int(words[1])
                dx := int(words[2])
                dy := int(words[3])
                for: index < count
                    iteration_state := state
                    iteration_state.matrix = iteration_state.matrix.translated(index * dx, index * dy)
                    .execute_block(position + 1, closing, layer_index, &iteration_state)
                position = closing + 1
            else
                entry := Command(source.number, words[0], words[1:<#words])
                int called := .execute(entry, layer_index, &state)
                if called >= 0
                    symbol_state := state
                    symbol := scene.symbols[called]
                    symbol_state.matrix = symbol_state.matrix.translated(entry.number(1), entry.number(2))
                    .execute_block(symbol.first, symbol.last, layer_index, &symbol_state)
                position += 1

    void .run()
        for: layer_index < #scene.layers
            block := scene.layers[layer_index]
            state := DrawingState(full_screen)
            .execute_block(block.first, block.last, int(layer_index), &state)

    string[] command_lines()
        string[] lines := []
        for: index < #executions
            entry := executions[index]
            prefix := "cmd {index + 1} line {entry.command.line} {entry.command.keyword}"
            suffix := if entry.kind == "error" then " error {entry.problem}" elif entry.kind == "state" then " ok" else " pixels {entry.pixels} box {entry.box}"
            lines = lines.append(prefix + suffix)
        return lines

    string[] layer_lines()
        lines := ["layers {#layers}"]
        for: layer_index < #layers
            layer := layers[layer_index]
            distinct<int> painted
            canvas.Color[] values := []
            for: pixel < #layer.painted
                if layer.painted[pixel]
                    .painted.add(int(pixel))
                    values = values.append(layer.colors[pixel])
            counts := color_counts(values)
            visible := 0
            for pixel := painted.values()[]
                shown := layer.alpha_at(pixel) > 0
                for: layer_index + 1 <= later < #layers
                    if layers[later].alpha_at(pixel) == 255
                        shown = false
                        break
                if shown
                    visible += 1
            commands := 0
            errors := 0
            for entry := executions[]
                if entry.layer == int(layer_index)
                    commands += 1
                    if entry.kind == "error"
                        errors += 1
            box := box_text(bounding_box(painted, scene.width, scene.height))
            lines = lines.append("layer {layer_index + 1} {scene.layers[layer_index].name} opacity {layer.opacity} mode {layer.mode} commands {commands} errors {errors} pixels {painted.size()} box {box} visible {visible} colors {counts.size()}")
            ranked := ranked_colors(counts)
            limit := math.min(5, int(#ranked))
            for: index < limit
                lines = lines.append("color {ranked[index].color.text()} pixels {ranked[index].count}")
        return lines

    string[] summary_lines(canvas.Color[] image)
        background := color_value(styles.colors, scene.background)
        drawing := 0
        state_count := 0
        errors := 0
        painted := 0
        erased := 0
        map<string, int> error_counts
        map<string, KeywordTally> keywords
        for entry := executions[]
            name := entry.command.keyword
            tally := KeywordTally()
            match keywords.get(name)
                KeywordTally previous
                    tally = previous
                none
                    tally = KeywordTally()
            tally.executed += 1
            tally.pixels += entry.pixels
            if entry.kind == "error"
                errors += 1
                tally.errors += 1
                .error_counts.set(entry.problem, count_at(error_counts, entry.problem) + 1)
            elif entry.kind == "state"
                state_count += 1
            else
                drawing += 1
                if name == "ERASE"
                    erased += entry.pixels
                else
                    painted += entry.pixels
            .keywords.set(name, tally)
        counts := color_counts(image)
        lines := ["canvas {scene.width} {scene.height}", "background {background.rgb_text()}", "layers {#layers}", "symbols {#scene.symbols}", "commands {#executions}", "drawing {drawing}", "state {state_count}", "errors {errors}"]
        for name := error_names()[]
            lines = lines.append("error {name} {count_at(error_counts, name)}")
        lines = lines.concat(["painted {painted}", "erased {erased}", "colors {counts.size()}"])
        ranked := ranked_colors(counts)
        limit := math.min(8, int(#ranked))
        for: index < limit
            lines = lines.append("top {index + 1} {ranked[index].color.rgb_text()} pixels {ranked[index].count}")
        string[] symbol_names := []
        for symbol := scene.symbols[]
            symbol_names = symbol_names.append(symbol.name)
        symbol_names = symbol_names.sorted()
        for name := symbol_names[]
            lines = lines.append("symbol {name} uses {count_at(symbol_uses, name)}")
        for name := keywords.keys().sorted()[]
            match keywords.get(name)
                KeywordTally tally
                    lines = lines.append("keyword {name} executed {tally.executed} errors {tally.errors} pixels {tally.pixels}")
                none
                    continue
        distinct<string> used_colors
        .used_colors.add(scene.background)
        for name := used_pens.values()[]
            pen := pen_value(styles.pens, name)
            .used_colors.add(pen.color_name)
        for name := used_brushes.values()[]
            brush := brush_value(styles.brushes, name)
            for color_name := brush.color_names[]
                .used_colors.add(color_name)
        distinct<string> used_symbols
        for name := symbol_uses.keys()[]
            .used_symbols.add(name)
        names := [styles.colors.keys(), styles.pens.keys(), styles.brushes.keys(), symbol_names]
        used := [used_colors, used_pens, used_brushes, used_symbols]
        kinds := ["color", "pen", "brush", "symbol"]
        string[] unused := []
        for: index < 4
            for name := names[index].sorted()[]
                if not used[index].has(name)
                    unused = unused.append("unused {kinds[index]} {name}")
        return lines.append("unused {#unused}").concat(unused)

    string[] probe_lines(canvas.Color[] image)
        string[] lines := []
        for: probe_index < #probes
            probe := probes[probe_index]
            values := probe.values
            if probe.kind == "point"
                x := values[0]
                y := values[1]
                pixel := y * scene.width + x
                string[] stack := []
                for: layer_index < #layers
                    if layers[layer_index].alpha_at(pixel) > 0
                        stack = stack.append("{layer_index + 1}:{layers[layer_index].lines[pixel]}")
                overlap := if #stack == 0 then "none" else stack.join(" ")
                lines = lines.append("point {probe_index + 1} {x} {y} rgb {image[pixel].rgb_text()} layers {#stack} stack {overlap}")
            else
                area := canvas.Rectangle(values[0], values[1], values[2], values[3])
                pixels := area.pixels(scene.width)
                sums := [0, 0, 0]
                cover := array(#layers, fill = 0)
                distinct<(int, int, int, int)> colors
                for pixel := pixels.values()[]
                    color := image[pixel]
                    sums[0] += color.r
                    sums[1] += color.g
                    sums[2] += color.b
                    .colors.add(color.key())
                    for: layer_index < #layers
                        if layers[layer_index].alpha_at(pixel) > 0
                            cover[layer_index] += 1
                string[] covering := []
                for count := cover[]
                    covering = covering.append(string(count))
                count := int(pixels.size())
                coverage_text := covering.join(" ")
                lines = lines.append("area {probe_index + 1} {values[0]} {values[1]} {values[2]} {values[3]} pixels {count} mean {sums[0] / count} {sums[1] / count} {sums[2] / count} colors {colors.size()} cover {coverage_text}")
        return lines

    void write_lines(string name, string[] lines)
        string text := if #lines == 0 then "" else lines.join(NL) + NL
        writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
        .writer1(text)

    void write_reports()
        background := color_value(styles.colors, scene.background)
        canvas.Color[] image := canvas.composite(layers, background, scene.width, scene.height)
        if not file.is_directory("output")
            file.mkdir("output")
        ppm.write_ppm("output/image.ppm", image, scene.width, scene.height)
        ppm.write_preview("output/preview.txt", image, scene.width, scene.height)
        write_lines("commands.txt", command_lines())
        write_lines("layers.txt", layer_lines())
        write_lines("summary.txt", summary_lines(image))
        write_lines("probes.txt", probe_lines(image))

if main
    renderer := Renderer(read_styles(), read_font(), read_scene(), read_probes())
    .renderer.run()
    renderer.write_reports()

import canvas = "./canvas.qui"

void write_ppm(string path, canvas.Color[] image, int width, int height)
    lines := ["P3", "{width} {height}", "255"]
    for: row < height
        string[] values := []
        for: column < width
            values = values.append(image[row * width + column].rgb_text())
        lines = lines.append(values.join(" "))
    writer1 := file.write(path)
    .writer1(lines.join(NL) + NL)

void write_preview(string path, canvas.Color[] image, int width, int height)
    ramp := "@%#*+=-:,."
    string[] lines := []
    for: top < height step 4
        text := ""
        for: left < width step 2
            total := 0
            for: top <= row < top + 4
                for: left <= column < left + 2
                    color := image[row * width + column]
                    total += 299 * color.r + 587 * color.g + 114 * color.b
            brightness := total / 8000
            text += ramp[brightness * 10 / 256]
        lines = lines.append(text)
    writer2 := file.write(path)
    .writer2(lines.join(NL) + NL)

import math
import canvas = "./canvas.qui"

canvas.Point[] bresenham(canvas.Point first, canvas.Point last)
    x := first.x
    y := first.y
    dx := math.abs(last.x - x)
    dy := -math.abs(last.y - y)
    sx := if x < last.x then 1 else -1
    sy := if y < last.y then 1 else -1
    error_value := dx + dy
    canvas.Point[] result := []
    while true
        result = result.append(canvas.Point(x, y))
        if x == last.x and y == last.y
            return result
        doubled := 2 * error_value
        if doubled >= dy
            error_value += dy
            x += sx
        if doubled <= dx
            error_value += dx
            y += sy

canvas.Point[] expand_square(canvas.Point point, int width)
    low := -((width - 1) / 2)
    canvas.Point[] result := []
    for: low <= row < low + width
        for: low <= column < low + width
            result = result.append(canvas.Point(point.x + column, point.y + row))
    return result

void add_point(distinct<(int, int)> &points, int x, int y)
    .points.add((x, y))

canvas.Point[] point_values(distinct<(int, int)> points)
    canvas.Point[] result := []
    for (x, y) := points.values()[]
        result = result.append(canvas.Point(x, y))
    return result

canvas.Point[] circle_points(int radius)
    distinct<(int, int)> points
    a := radius
    b := 0
    error_value := 1 - radius
    while a >= b
        int[][] positions := [[a, b], [b, a], [-b, a], [-a, b], [-a, -b], [-b, -a], [b, -a], [a, -b]]
        for position := positions[]
            add_point(&points, position[0], position[1])
        b += 1
        if error_value < 0
            error_value += 2 * b + 1
        else
            a -= 1
            error_value += 2 * (b - a) + 1
    return point_values(points)

void add_quadrants(distinct<(int, int)> &points, int x, int y)
    add_point(&points, x, y)
    add_point(&points, -x, y)
    add_point(&points, x, -y)
    add_point(&points, -x, -y)

canvas.Point[] ellipse_points(int rx, int ry)
    rx2 := rx * rx
    ry2 := ry * ry
    x := 0
    y := ry
    distinct<(int, int)> points
    add_point(&points, 0, ry)
    add_point(&points, 0, -ry)
    while ry2 * x < rx2 * y
        decision := 4 * ry2 * (x + 1) * (x + 1) + rx2 * (2 * y - 1) * (2 * y - 1) - 4 * rx2 * ry2
        x += 1
        if decision >= 0
            y -= 1
        add_quadrants(&points, x, y)
    while y > 0
        decision := ry2 * (2 * x + 1) * (2 * x + 1) + 4 * rx2 * (y - 1) * (y - 1) - 4 * rx2 * ry2
        y -= 1
        if decision <= 0
            x += 1
        add_quadrants(&points, x, y)
    return point_values(points)

canvas.Point[] bezier_points(canvas.Point[] controls, int segments)
    degree := int(#controls) - 1
    scale := if degree == 2 then segments * segments else segments * segments * segments
    canvas.Point[] result := []
    for: index <= segments
        rest := segments - index
        int[] weights := if degree == 2 then [rest * rest, 2 * index * rest, index * index] else [rest * rest * rest, 3 * index * rest * rest, 3 * index * index * rest, index * index * index]
        x := 0
        y := 0
        for: position < #controls
            x += weights[position] * controls[position].x
            y += weights[position] * controls[position].y
        result = result.append(canvas.Point(canvas.round_ratio(x, scale), canvas.round_ratio(y, scale)))
    return result
